theorems.statement: (∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (R : IMRep U n), IsOpen U → R.Represents T → ∀ W : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen W → T.massOn W = R.measure W) → ∀ (P k : ℕ) (s : Finset ((Fin k → Fin P) × (Fin P → ℤ))) (β : (Fin k → Fin P) × (Fin P → ℤ) → ℤ) (T : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) k), (∀ p ∈ s, StrictMono p.1) → (∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) k, T ω = ∑ p ∈ s, (β p : ℝ) * ∫ y in {y : Euclid k | ∀ i, 0 < y i ∧ y i < 1}, (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) k) (WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i => (p.2 i : ℝ)) + ∑ j, y j • EuclideanSpace.single (p.1 j) (1 : ℝ)) (fun j => EuclideanSpace.single (p.1 j) (1 : ℝ))) → IsIntegerMultiplicity T ∧ T.mass = ENNReal.ofReal (∑ p ∈ s, |(β p : ℝ)|) ∧ (T = 0 ∨ 1 ≤ T.mass)
